paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, at the end of Maaserot, as saying in the name of R' Abahu.[^1]

notes.text: Ba in the heading and Abahu in the body have abbreviated titles, retained as R'. Relative does not specify a closer kinship. End of Maaserot remains the supplied tractate-end locator, without an exact independently checked passage or identity binding.
